title: GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab EE affecting all versions from 16.10 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and…
description: A vulnerability in GitLab EE versions from 16.10 before 19.3.9, 19.4 before 19.4.8, and 19.5 before 19.5.6 allowed authenticated users to configure GitLab Duo settings for groups without an eligible license due to missing authorization checks. This issue has been remediated by GitLab.
